qualification.package: Clean public wheel from the tagged source; both unprivileged image imports report 0.15.0, the 2048x2048x124 SM120 resident budget and the 2720-pixel native-HD bound. Offline layers reuse the same immutable dependency images as 0.14.0, with no model payloads.
qualification.engine: Three complete I2VA requests on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GiB) with the resident FP8 trunk, Veda 44/6, two-step face and six-step audio repair: 1920x1088/5 s (163 s), 2720x1536/5 s (261 s) and 1920x1088/10 s (245 s), 42.1 GiB peak device memory, coherent start/middle/end frames and a native 4 MP crop without tiling. The GPU runs used the pre-release build of implementation commit a367654, which differs from this release only in its version string. Numerical paths are unchanged from 0.14.0.
qualification.limits: Capacity and visual qualification on SM120 only, not sound quality. SM90 keeps its 1536x864 resident envelope; block ring remains the default. Application capacity and lane declarations are separate.
